blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Дурные вести, как вода, просачиваются сквозь ___ (малейшие скважины).
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.
